description: This file implements a generic file caching system with asynchronous loading, static file fallback, and cache freshness validation, primarily used for managing cached file contents in a web server context.

classes.name: Cached
classes.description: A thread-safe cache entry holding file content and last checked timestamp.

classes.name: FileCache
classes.description: A generic asynchronous file cache with static fallback files.

methods.name: Cached::new
methods.description: Creates a new cache entry with initial content and current check time.

methods.name: Cached::last_check_time
methods.description: Returns the last check time as a DateTime<Utc>.

methods.name: Cached::update_check_time
methods.description: Updates the last checked timestamp to now.

methods.name: Cached::elapsed
methods.description: Calculates elapsed time in milliseconds since epoch divided by cache stale threshold.

methods.name: Cached::needs_check
methods.description: Determines if the cache needs to be refreshed based on elapsed time.

methods.name: Cached::make_fresh
methods.description: Creates a new cache entry with the same content but updated check time.

methods.name: FileCache::add_static
methods.description: Adds a static file to the cache as fallback.

methods.name: FileCache::get
methods.description: Retrieves a file from cache or loads it from disk.

methods.name: FileCache::get_static
methods.description: Retrieves a static file from cache.

methods.name: FileCache::get_with_privilege
methods.description: Retrieves a file with privilege check, loading from disk if necessary.
